name: blm-mcp-proxy
description: Proxies Claude tool calls to the BLM Analytics backend for NSE India market data, screener.in fundamentals, watchlists, and news.

remote_host.title: Backend Server Host
remote_host.description: Hostname or IP of the BLM backend server

remote_port.title: Backend Server Port
remote_port.description: Port the BLM backend MCP server is listening on

remote_path.title: Backend MCP Path
remote_path.description: URL path for the MCP endpoint on the backend server

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Check backend service health and connectivity.

tools.name: get_top_gainers
tools.description: Fetch today's top-gaining NSE equities ranked by intraday percentage change. Supports optional category filter: NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, NIFTYNEXT50, SecGtr20, SecLwr20, FOSec, allSec (default).

tools.name: get_top_losers
tools.description: Fetch today's top-losing NSE equities ranked by intraday percentage change. Supports optional category filter: NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, NIFTYNEXT50, SecGtr20, SecLwr20, FOSec, allSec (default).

tools.name: get_bulk_deals
tools.description: Fetch recent NSE bulk deal records for a given stock symbol.

tools.name: get_block_deals
tools.description: Fetch recent NSE block deal records for a given stock symbol.

tools.name: get_high_short_interest
tools.description: Fetch today's NSE stocks flagged for high short-selling interest.

tools.name: get_largedeal_snapshot
tools.description: Fetch a combined real-time snapshot of NSE insider, bulk, and block deals across all stocks.

tools.name: get_change_ranges
tools.description: Fetch NSE percentage price changes across multiple timeframes (1d to 5y) for a symbol.

tools.name: get_symbol_data
tools.description: Fetch live NSE quote data for a symbol, including LTP, 52-week range, sector, and industry.

tools.name: get_52week_low_stocks
tools.description: Fetch NSE stocks that crossed a new 52-week low today.

tools.name: get_52week_high_stocks
tools.description: Fetch NSE stocks that crossed a new 52-week high today.

tools.name: get_volume_gainers
tools.description: Fetch NSE stocks with the largest volume surge relative to their weekly average.

tools.name: screener_search
tools.description: Search screener.in for NSE companies by name or symbol fragment.

tools.name: screener_company
tools.description: Fetch fundamental ratios and quarterly results for an NSE company from screener.in.

tools.name: screener_trades
tools.description: Fetch insider trades, bulk deals, and block deals for an NSE company from screener.in.

tools.name: run_tql_screener
tools.description: Run a custom TQL (Ticker Query Language) screener query against all NSE stocks. Supports RSI, ATR, MACD, BBWidth, BBSqueeze, PE, Volume, Close, Change, MomentumScore, Return1w/1m/3m/6m/1y, From52wHigh/Low, Sector, Industry with AND/OR/NOT logic. Interval prefixes supported: 1h:RSI, W:ATR, M:MACD.

tools.name: get_company_quarterly_results
tools.description: Fetch all available quarterly financial results for an NSE company from screener.in.

tools.name: list_stock_universe
tools.description: List all tracked NSE stocks with symbol, company name, sector, industry, and PE data.

tools.name: get_stock_universe
tools.description: Look up NSE stock universe metadata by symbol — prefer screener_company for deeper research.

tools.name: search_stock_universe
tools.description: Search tracked NSE stocks by symbol or company name prefix.

tools.name: optimize_portfolio
tools.description: Run portfolio optimization on a list of NSE symbols using mean-variance or hierarchical risk parity. Returns portfolio weights, expected annual return/volatility/Sharpe, correlation matrix, and per-symbol stats. Supports 'max_sharpe', 'min_volatility', and 'risk_parity' objectives with 1y/2y/3y lookback.

tools.name: create_watchlist
tools.description: Create a new named watchlist. Returns the created watchlist with its id and creation timestamp.

tools.name: add_watchlist_item
tools.description: Add a single symbol/exchange pair to a named watchlist. Idempotent — returns the existing row if already present.

tools.name: bulk_replace_watchlist
tools.description: Atomically replace all items in a watchlist with a new set of symbols. Use this to save an optimized portfolio — deletes all existing items and inserts the new set in a single transaction.

tools.name: list_watchlist
tools.description: List all items in the default watchlist (ID 1), ordered by time added.

tools.name: get_watchlist_symbols
tools.description: Fetch distinct symbols from the default watchlist as a flat list.

tools.name: remove_watchlist_item
tools.description: Delete a watchlist item from the default watchlist by its numeric ID.

tools.name: list_watchlists
tools.description: List all user-created watchlists with name and item count.

tools.name: get_watchlist_items
tools.description: Fetch all symbol/exchange items in a watchlist by its numeric ID.

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: Fetch unread market-event notifications for a watchlist, newest first.

tools.name: get_global_notifications
tools.description: Fetch unread global NSE scan alerts across all stocks, with optional type and count filters.

tools.name: get_morningstar_fairvalue
tools.description: Fetch Morningstar fair value estimate and uncertainty rating for an NSE stock symbol.

tools.name: get_global_news
tools.description: Fetch recent financial news from MoneyControl and 35+ RSS sources (Bloomberg, Reuters, CNBC, Economic Times, Mint, etc.) with NLP sentiment analysis, threat classification, and entity extraction. Supports filtering by source, sentiment, threat level, and language.

tools.name: get_company_news
tools.description: Fetch news articles for an NSE company with NLP sentiment, threat level, entity extraction, and source credibility ratings. Supports filtering by sentiment, threat level, and language.

tools.name: list_industries
tools.description: List all NSE industries with market cap, PE ratio, advance/decline counts, and sentiment.

tools.name: list_sectors
tools.description: List all NSE sectors with market cap, PE ratio, advance/decline counts, and sentiment.

tools.name: get_industry_stocks
tools.description: Fetch all NSE stocks in a given industry by slug, sorted by market cap descending.

tools.name: get_sector_stocks
tools.description: Fetch all NSE stocks in a given sector by slug, sorted by market cap descending.
